appVersion.description: AppVersion is the app version of the release.

chart.description: Chart is the chart that was released.

chartReference.description: ChartReference are the labels that are used to identify the chart source.

config.description:
Config is the set of extra Values added to the chart.
These values override the default values inside of the chart.

hooks.description: Hooks are all of the hooks declared for this release.

info.description: Info provides information about a release

manifest.description: Manifest is the string representation of the rendered template.

name.description: Name is the name of the release

namespace.description: Namespace is the kubernetes namespace of the release.

stackID.description: StackID is the ID of the Portainer stack associated with this release (if using GitOps)

values.description: Values are the values used to deploy the chart.

version.description: Version is an int which represents the revision of the release.

delete_policies.description: DeletePolicies are the policies that indicate when to delete the hook

events.description: Events are the events that this hook fires on.

last_run.description: LastRun indicates the date/time this was last run.

path.description: Path is the chart-relative path to the template.

weight.description: Weight indicates the sort order for execution among similar Hook type

completed_at.description: CompletedAt indicates the date/time this hook was completed.

phase.description: Phase indicates whether the hook completed successfully

started_at.description: StartedAt indicates the date/time this hook was started

deleted.description: Deleted tracks when this object was deleted.

description.description: Description is human-friendly "log entry" about this release.

first_deployed.description: FirstDeployed is when the release was first deployed.

last_deployed.description: LastDeployed is when the release was last deployed.

notes.description: Contains the rendered templates/NOTES.txt if available

resources.description: Resources is the list of resources that are part of the release

status.description: Status is the current state of the release

files.description:
Files are miscellaneous files in a chart archive,
e.g. README, LICENSE, etc.

lock.description: Lock is the contents of Chart.lock.

metadata.description: Metadata is the contents of the Chartfile.

schema.description: Schema is an optional JSON schema for imposing structure on Values

values.description: Values are default config for this chart.

alias.description: Alias usable alias to be used for the chart

condition.description: A yaml path that resolves to a boolean, used for enabling/disabling charts (e.g. subchart1.enabled )

enabled.description: Enabled bool determines if chart should be loaded

import-values.description:
ImportValues holds the mapping of source values to parent key to be imported. Each item can be a
string or pair of child/parent sublist items.

name.description:
Name is the name of the dependency.

This must mach the name in the dependency's Chart.yaml.

repository.description:
The URL to the repository.

Appending `index.yaml` to this string should result in a URL that can be
used to fetch the repository index.

tags.description: Tags can be used to group charts for enabling/disabling together

version.description:
Version is the version (range) of this chart.

A lock file will always produce a single version, while a dependency
may contain a semantic version range.

data.description: Data is the template as byte data.

name.description: Name is the path-like name of the template.

dependencies.description: Dependencies is the list of dependencies that this lock file has locked.

digest.description: Digest is a hash of the dependencies in Chart.yaml.

generated.description: Generated is the date the lock file was last generated.

email.description: Email is an optional email address to contact the named maintainer

name.description: Name is a user name or organization name

url.description: URL is an optional URL to an address for the named maintainer

annotations.description:
Annotations are additional mappings uninterpreted by Helm,
made available for inspection by other applications.

apiVersion.description: The API Version of this chart. Required.

appVersion.description: The version of the application enclosed inside of this chart.

condition.description: The condition to check to enable chart

dependencies.description: Dependencies are a list of dependencies for a chart.

deprecated.description: Whether or not this chart is deprecated

description.description: A one-sentence description of the chart

home.description: The URL to a relevant project page, git repo, or contact person

icon.description: The URL to an icon file.

kubeVersion.description: KubeVersion is a SemVer constraint specifying the version of Kubernetes required.

maintainers.description: A list of name and URL/email address combinations for the maintainer(s)

name.description: The name of the chart. Required.

sources.description: Source is the URL to the source code of this chart

tags.description: The tags to check to enable chart

type.description: Specifies the chart type: application or library

version.description: A SemVer 2 conformant version string of the chart. Required.
